title: 8-Week AI PM Learning Roadmap
intro: Designed for ~4–6 hours/week alongside a full-time PM job. Each week has a Do (hands-on, non-negotiable) and a Consume (reading/watching, ~2 hrs) list.

weeks.title: How LLMs actually work
weeks.do: Create accounts on ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. Run the same 5 prompts across all three and log differences in tone, accuracy, and refusals in a simple spreadsheet.
weeks.consume: Andrej Karpathy's 'Intro to Large Language Models' (YouTube); DeepLearning.AI 'Generative AI for Everyone' (Week 1 module).
weeks.outcome: You can explain tokens, context windows, and why the same prompt gives different answers.

weeks.title: The AI product landscape
weeks.do: Pick 3 AI products you use (e.g., Notion AI, GitHub Copilot, Perplexity) and write a 1-page teardown each: core AI capability, where it fails, how errors/fallbacks are handled.
weeks.consume: Subscribe to One Useful Thing (Ethan Mollick), read the last 5 posts; skim a Latent Space 'state of AI' roundup.
weeks.outcome: A mental map of what 'good' AI UX looks like, and common failure patterns.

weeks.title: Prompting & RAG
weeks.do: Complete DeepLearning.AI's 'ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers' (free, ~1.5 hrs). Build a prompt template + a simple RAG Q&A over a PDF using a no-code tool (e.g., NotebookLM).
weeks.consume: Read a primer on RAG vs. fine-tuning vs. prompting tradeoffs from a reputable ML blog.
weeks.outcome: You can correctly recommend prompting vs. RAG vs. fine-tuning for a given use case in a design review.

weeks.title: Agents & evaluation
weeks.do: Build a simple multi-step agent (n8n, Zapier AI, or a LangChain template) chaining 2–3 actions. Write 10 test cases (an 'eval set') and manually score outputs.
weeks.consume: Interconnects (Nathan Lambert) — one deep post on model training/evals; explore Reforge/Maven syllabi for evaluation frameworks.
weeks.outcome: You understand what an 'eval' is and can design one — one of the most in-demand AI PM skills right now.

weeks.title: Writing AI-native PRDs
weeks.do: Rewrite a past (non-AI) PRD as an AI feature: add data requirements, model/prompt rationale, evaluation criteria, guardrails/fallback UX, and a monitoring plan.
weeks.consume: Lenny's Newsletter AI-PM posts and Aakash Gupta's (Product Growth) AI PM playbooks.
weeks.outcome: A portfolio-ready AI PRD template you can reuse.

weeks.title: Responsible AI & data strategy
weeks.do: Audit an AI feature for bias/fairness/privacy risk using a simple checklist (data provenance, consent, explainability, human-override path). Draft a one-page 'Responsible AI checklist'.
weeks.consume: Skim the EU AI Act risk-tiers summary and India's DPDP Act overview (official/reputable sources); read one responsible-AI case study.
weeks.outcome: You can proactively flag ethical/compliance risk in a product review.

weeks.title: Build a small AI feature end-to-end
weeks.do: Using a no-code/low-code AI builder (Bubble + OpenAI API, Retool AI, Voiceflow), ship one small working AI feature end-to-end, including a basic eval and usage dashboard.
weeks.consume: Watch 2–3 case-study videos of AI PMs describing how they scoped/shipped AI features.
weeks.outcome: A working, demoable AI feature you built yourself.

weeks.title: Portfolio & positioning
weeks.do: Compile Weeks 1–7 outputs into a portfolio: 1 AI product teardown, 1 AI PRD, 1 eval set, 1 responsible-AI checklist, 1 shipped mini-feature with a demo. Update LinkedIn/resume with real AI PM job-description keywords.
weeks.consume: Re-read the self-assessment checklist and re-score yourself.
weeks.outcome: A tangible, interview-ready portfolio plus a resume tuned to what employers actually ask for.

after: Block 30 min/week for your top 2–3 newsletters, ship one small AI-touchpoint experiment per quarter, and re-run the self-assessment every quarter.
